item.title: How to Clear All Commit History from a Git Repository
item.description: Here we take clearing the entire commit history of the main branch as the example. Switch to the main branch 1 git checkout main Create a clean branch 1 git checkout --orphan new_main Commit all files 1 2 git add -A git commit -m "msg" Delete the main branch 1 git branch -D main Rename the new branch to main 1 git branch -m main Force push to the remote repository 1 git push -f origin main

item.title: How to Synchronize and Back Up a Git Repository
item.description: Because the Git repository currently in use is about to become unavailable, the repository code needs to be migrated to a new Git repository. The specific procedure is as follows: Log in to the new repository and create a repository. After creation, the new repository address is: http://gitlab.your-new-domain.com/project.git Clone the old repository as a mirror locally: 1 2 3 git clone --mirror http://gitlab.
